text: This facade belongs to the Secession style that reshaped Timișoara in the early twentieth century. Look for the carved mask above the window: Secession architects used faces and flowing plant motifs to give buildings personality and civic pride.

enrichments.historical_context: In the early 1900s, as Timișoara grew beyond its old fortress walls, many new apartment buildings adopted the Secession style that was popular across Austria-Hungary.
enrichments.why_it_matters: Secession facades are a defining part of Timișoara's architectural identity.
